route.observation: The opcode switch case 0x000D passes packet+0x10 directly to FUN_00DA76B0. It reads body+0x00 as a u32 for a numeric logger and body+0x09 as a u8 for the count logger before the call. BCS-Y-0017 supplies the pre-existing catalog identity.
The parser indexes 0x1D0-byte record windows from the packet body and projects new keys into a 0x2E0-stride slot vector.

fields.name: control_flags

The return value is the inverse of bit 0. A set bit returns 0 to FUN_00DAA9F0, which calls FUN_00DA5030 and returns 0.

fields.name: append_c_string
observations: The source scan includes the NUL terminator in the copied length.
The destination scan begins at slot+0x40 and appends at its first NUL.
Neither scan nor the append has a record, destination, or capacity bound in this function.

wireRecord.opaqueBoundary: All bytes not named above remain opaque. In particular, no noun is assigned inside record+0x19..0x4F or after the append string terminator through record+0x1CF.

behavior.existingKey: Append the record+0x50 C string, including its NUL, to the first NUL at destination slot+0x40. No new slot is inserted.
behavior.newKey: Copy record+0x10 for 0x1D0 bytes, zero destination+0x1D0 for 0x100 bytes, initialize an empty embedded vector, push one 0x2E0 slot, then join matching 0x30-stride operation records through FUN_00DA9550.
behavior.emptyCount: Skip the record loop and return the inverse of control_flags bit 0.
behavior.paginationBoundary: Repeated records with the same low-six-bit key append their record+0x50 strings. The client supplies no explicit total-length or page-count check in this parser.
behavior.recordWindowBoundary: The new-key copy reads through record+0x1DF, 0x10 bytes beyond the nominal 0x1D0 window. For index N this is the next window's leading 0x10 bytes; the caller passes no payload length to the parser.

validationAndFailure: Vector begin/end inversions and out-of-range slot indexes call FUN_009D22B4.
FUN_00891F00 uses in-capacity construction when possible; otherwise FUN_00891E50 validates the vector state and grows it through FUN_00891B20.
FUN_008913E0 constructs only when the destination pointer is nonzero.
FUN_00890EE0 derives embedded-vector element count at stride 0x30, initializes destination begin/end/capacity to zero, and rejects a count above 0x05555555 through FUN_006D20B0 before allocation.
FUN_00DA76B0 performs no payload-length validation, no record-count-to-length validation, and no bound check on either C-string scan or the append copy.

captureCorrelation.sessionComparison: Both retained lobby sessions begin their decrypted type-3 opcode sequence with 0x000C. Type 0x000D is absent from deterministic session-a and occurs once in session-b, so no type-0x000D byte can be classified invariant or dynamic across sessions. The labels do not assert capture chronology.
captureCorrelation.observedShape: The sole type-0x000D body has capacity for two 0x1D0 entries after its 0x10-byte leading frame, while the client-read count is one and the unused capacity entry is zero. The active append C string terminates inside both the record window and the 0x1D0 copy source.
